description.value: Balkan Bakery is a small East Vancouver artisan bakery specializing in traditional Balkan phyllo pastries — hand-stretched pita and flaky burek filled with meat, cheese, spinach, or potato — alongside handcrafted empanadas and a full organic espresso bar. The shop prides itself on freshly made products using high-quality ingredients and traditional techniques rooted in Balkan home-baking culture. It sits in a residential-commercial neighbourhood with street-level access and car parking front and rear, making it a practical savory-snack stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms an active bakery at 5728 Tyne St, Vancouver selling Balkan-style phyllo pastries, empanadas, and organic coffee drinks. OSM tags corroborate the name, street address, and website URL; the website provides a phone number absent from OSM. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; only car parking is referenced ('Park in front or behind our store').
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: front page lists V5R 5L6 while the contact page lists V5R 5L4 — unable to confirm which is correct.

Website contains an undeleted default WordPress placeholder page ('Página de ejemplo') in Spanish, suggesting the site was built from a Spanish-language template and not fully cleaned up; does not affect business legitimacy.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bakery with an active website and confirmed address; a useful snack-and-coffee stop for touring cyclists.
